title: SWF: accessibility tab-order not compiled — tabIndex/tabEnabled never emitted
description: The model supports accessibility.useCustomTabOrder and per-display-object tabIndex/tabEnabled (confirmed in accessibility.test.ts) but compile.ts and sprite.ts never emit the corresponding AS2 DoAction script (_root.tabEnabled=false; obj.tabIndex=N;) or EnableAccessibility SWF tag. Flash Player custom tab order is purely AS2-driven so without generated code the property has no effect. Emit a DoAction script per frame with tabIndex/tabEnabled assignments.
